newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: K.Emas writes off Solomon timber assets.
newsitem.headline: K.Emas writes off Solomon timber assets.

text.p: Malaysia's Kumpulan Emas Bhd said on Friday it was writing off 350.6 million ringgit from the net book value of a part of its timber concessions on the Solomon islands.
In a statement, the engineering and timber firm said the group's share of the extraordinary loss after minority interests of the write-off is 313.8 million ringgit.
Emas said the write-off was done after timber stock reviews by two valuers in the concessions owned by subsidiaries, Isabel Timber Co Ltd, Integrated Forest Industries Ltd and Rural Industries Ltd.
The valuers concluded that the saleable value of the timber that could be extracted was lower than had previously been estimated.
Emas said a timber stock review of fourth concession owned by subsidiary Silvania Products Ltd was not done as Emas has substantially completed logging in the area.
Emas is also depreciating the value of its investment in Emas Pacific Ltd, the holding company of the three Solomon subsidiaries, by 300.6 million ringgit.
Separately, Emas was writing up the value of its investment in its subsidiaries and a landed property by 206.9 million ringgit.
The net effect of these moves will reduce group net tangible assets per share by 61 cents to 1.60 ringgit.
